details.s: Durin I of Khazad-dûm, known also as Durin the Deathless, was the oldest of the Seven Fathers of the Dwarves, first created by Aulë the Vala; and as such, the first living being that was not of the Ainur.
f: King of Durin's Folk, King of Khazad-dûm
